I've been reading his manifesto (note: the revised version that's considered legal in Sweden), and there's one thing I don't understand.

If industrial society is nearly impossible to kill, why should anyone attempt to struggle against it? It seems like one of those impossible-to-achieve goals that Ted says makes us unhappy. 

Instead of "muh power process", why not satisfy people directly, through things like drugs and escapism? Cut out the middleman, so to speak.
